name: personalized-product-recommendation
description: Personalized Product Recommendation Model with Streamlit UI and FastAPI backend

scripts.dev: export PATH=$PATH:/root/.local/bin && streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py --server.port 3000 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
scripts.start: export PATH=$PATH:/root/.local/bin && streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py --server.port 3000 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
scripts.lint: python3 -m py_compile src/data/*.py src/recommendation/*.py src/utils/*.py tests/*.py
